seoTitle: Geometry Calculator: Area, Perimeter, Volume and Surface Area of 16 Shapes
metaDescription: Pick a shape and enter its dimensions to get area, perimeter, volume or surface area with the formula for each result. Free.
intro: Calculates area, perimeter, volume or surface area for 16 common 2D and 3D shapes and prints the formula for every result.
why:
Circles, trapezoids, cones and tori each need their own formula. Choose a shape, enter its dimensions and the page shows each quantity with the formula behind it, which is handy for homework and for checking a design.

Triangles can be given by three sides (Heron) or by base and height. The ellipse perimeter is computed by numerical integration, not by an approximation formula. There is no diagram; the dimension names in the shape menu tell you what to enter. Lengths use your own unit u, so areas are in u squared and volumes in u cubed.
howTo: Choose a shape from the list.
Enter its dimensions in the numbered fields.
Leave optional fields blank if you do not have them.
Read each result with its formula.
